blocks.text: Kai Del Rio, professionally known as Kai Honasan, is set to release her new single, “Call Me When You’re Tired,” which is one of three original songs she wrote for the Alden Richards and Nadine Lustre-led series “Love, Siargao.” The single, scheduled to hit digital streaming platforms on Friday, Oct. 9, is produced by Migz Haleco.
